name: dsh-session-time-bucket
description: Standalone time-bucket grouping for the DSH Web sidebar session section. Adds its own clock entry beside the core view-options button (no core-menu injection: core ui-workspace's 分组方式 menu proved unsafe to extend). The entry opens a self-drawn popover (分组方式 → 按时间桶; picking it reveals a hairline-separated 显示工作区 row). Activating takes over the section with a compact plugin header (entry · 按时间桶 · 显示工作区 · ＋new session · ×exit) above a time-bucketed session list (今天/昨天/前7天/前30天/更早 by local calendar day, updatedAt desc, count + collapsible headers, trailing relative times, empty buckets hidden, archived/subagent filtered like core). While active the popover shows 按时间桶 selected + live 显示工作区; unchecking exits. Rows open via sessions.open; ＋new follows the current session's workspace; mode + 显示工作区 + folded buckets persist to localStorage. Client-only: reads the core sessions/workspaces services, ships no host endpoint and no model tool.
